subject: persona-selection-and-boundaries
positive_triggers: A software task benefits from a requirements, architecture, security, implementation, review, writing, reliability, or delivery perspective.
The user asks to combine multiple professional viewpoints on a cross-cutting change.
negative_triggers: The user asks for a direct factual answer that does not need a role-focused viewpoint.
The user asks for a repeatable procedure that should be handled by a skill when one is available.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: In an isolated copy, respond to these requests: (1) clarify a feature request with missing acceptance criteria; (2) compare two service designs; (3) review an authentication change for security and code-quality concerns; (4) assess an outage and propose a pipeline change. Do not edit files, access cloud resources, or trigger deployments.
pass_criteria: Selects only relevant personas and explains their distinct contributions when multiple are used.
Distinguishes personas as viewpoints from skills as repeatable procedures.
Keeps SRE focused on service reliability and operations, and DevOps focused on build, delivery, and platform automation, while identifying collaboration where appropriate.
Treats persona recommendations as analysis, not approved decisions or authorization to make changes.
Asks focused questions when missing information would materially change the work and preserves unresolved questions.
Does not claim this evaluation passed unless it was run and reviewed.
